editions.subject: DeepStack Weekly No. 3: The Cash Arrives Unevenly
editions.preheader: Microsoft pays for its data centers from its own cash with room to spare. Alphabet and Meta now spend most of theirs and Amazon more than all of it; Alphabet and Amazon have covered the gap with stock and bonds. DeepStack reads the filings company by company and names the October 28 report that tests the view. 10-year Treasury at 5.09%.
